profile.name: GRBL三轴运动平台
profile.description: 这是一种基于 GRBL 控制器的三轴电动运动平台，通常由 Arduino Uno 与 CNC Shield 驱动 X、Y、Z 轴步进电机。设备支持回零、限位开关、相对/绝对定位，以及简单的激光强度和 LED 控制，可用于实验室中的样品托盘、载台或小型自动化机构的移动、定位与振动操作。
profile.description_en: This is a GRBL-based 3-axis motorized motion stage, typically driven by an Arduino Uno and CNC shield to control X, Y, and Z stepper motors. It supports homing, limit switches, relative and absolute positioning, and simple laser intensity and LED control, making it useful for moving, positioning, and shaking sample plates, stages, or small laboratory automation mechanisms.
